patterns.costZH: 会丢失 Cursor MCP 服务器配置（可能包含服务授权与密钥）。
patterns.costEN: Removes Cursor MCP server configuration (may contain credentials/keys).
patterns.recoveryZH: 废纸篓还原或重新配置。

patterns.costZH: 聊天/历史索引库（含 .backup、-wal、-shm）。删除后 Cursor 会话可能永久卡在“Loading Chat…”，且无法从工作区重建索引。
patterns.costEN: Chat/history index DB (incl. .backup, -wal, -shm). Deleting can leave Cursor stuck on "Loading Chat…" forever; the index cannot be rebuilt from workspace DBs.
patterns.recoveryZH: 从废纸篓或 .backup 还原；优先用 Cursor 命令面板的 “Developer: Delete Old Chats” / “GC Agent KV Blobs”，不要直接删这个库文件。
patterns.recoveryEN: Restore from Trash or the .backup; prefer Cursor's "Developer: Delete Old Chats" / "GC Agent KV Blobs" commands instead of deleting this DB file.

patterns.costZH: 检查点/快照状态（Cursor 会话回退点）。删除后已保存的检查点/快照可能丢失；你的代码与设置通常仍在。Cursor 运行时可能很快重新生成（数天内可堆到上百 GB），建议先退出 Cursor 再处理（进程守卫已有帮助）；这不是失控写入的永久解法，也绝不判为 Safe。
patterns.costEN: Checkpoint/snapshot state (Cursor session restore points). Deleting may lose saved checkpoints/snapshots; your code and settings are usually kept. Cursor may rapidly recreate these while running (can pile up to hundreds of GB in days)—prefer quitting Cursor first (the process guard already helps); this is not a permanent fix for a runaway writer, and it is never Safe.
patterns.recoveryZH: 从废纸篓还原；建议先退出 Cursor 再清理，避免边删边写反复重建。
patterns.recoveryEN: Restore from Trash; quit Cursor before cleanup to avoid delete-while-writing churn.

patterns.costZH: 快照/检查点 .pack 数据块（Cursor 会话回退状态）。删除后对应检查点可能丢失；代码与设置通常仍在。Cursor 运行时可能很快重新生成并持续膨胀，建议先退出 Cursor 再处理；这不是失控写入的永久解法，也绝不判为 Safe。
patterns.costEN: Snapshot/checkpoint .pack chunk (Cursor session restore state). Deleting may lose that checkpoint; code and settings are usually kept. Cursor may rapidly recreate and keep growing these while running—prefer quitting Cursor first; this is not a permanent fix for a runaway writer, and it is never Safe.
patterns.recoveryZH: 从废纸篓还原；建议先退出 Cursor 再清理，避免边删边写反复重建。
patterns.recoveryEN: Restore from Trash; quit Cursor before cleanup to avoid delete-while-writing churn.
